name: Wild Hunt Huntsmaster

notes.languages: Speak with animals, Speak with plants

spells.name: Nature's Enmity
spells.text:
Animals, plants, and fungi in the area turn against the targets. Each target suffers from the following effects as long as it remains in the area.
- Vegetation springs up from every surface, giving each target a –10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speed any time it's adjacent to the plants and fungi.
- Aggressive animals attack unpredictably. At the start of its turn, each target rolls a DC 8 Flat check. On a failure, it's attacked by creatures that deal 2d10 slashing damage. The target attempts a basic Reflex save and is Off-Guard for 1 round on any outcome other than a critical success.
- The target loses any connection to nature or natural creatures. The target must succeed at a DC 5 Flat check when casting any primal spell or the spell fails. Furthermore, animal, fungus, and plant creatures become hostile to it, even one with a strong bond to the target, such as an animal companion.

The GM might decide that you can't subject some creatures, such as an emissary of a nature deity, to the ire of nature.

spells.name: Punishing Winds
spells.text:
Area (continued) 30-foot-radius, 100-foot-tall cylinder

---
Violent winds and a powerful downdraft fill the area, forming a cyclone. All flying creatures in the area descend 40 feet. The entire area is greater difficult terrain for Flying creatures, and difficult terrain for creatures on the ground or Climbing. Any creature that ends its turn Flying within the area descends 20 feet. Any creature pushed into a surface by this spell's winds takes bludgeoning damage as though it had fallen.

The squares at the outside vertical edges of the cylinder prevent creatures from leaving. These squares are greater difficult terrain, and a creature attempting to push through must succeed at an Athletics check or Acrobatics check to Maneuver in Flight against your spell DC to get through. A creature that fails ends its current action but can try again.

spells.name: Unfettered Pack
spells.text:
You free those who travel alongside you from environmental hindrances. Targets don't take circumstance penalties to Speed from vegetation, rubble, winds, or other properties of the environment, and they ignore difficult terrain from such environmental properties.

---

Heightened (9th) The targets also ignore greater difficult terrain from environmental properties.

spells.name: Speak with Stones
spells.text:
You can ask questions of and receive answers from natural or worked stone. While stone is not intelligent, you speak with the natural spirits of the stone, which have a personality colored by the type of stone, as well as by the type of structure the stone is part of, for worked stone. A stone's perspective, perception, and knowledge give it a worldview different enough from a human's that it doesn't consider the same details important. Stones can mostly answer questions about creatures that touched them in the past and what is concealed beneath or behind them.

---

Heightened (6th) The duration is 8 hours.

spells.name: Speak with Plants (Constant)
spells.text:
You can ask questions of and receive answers from plants and fungi, but the spell doesn't make them more friendly or intelligent than normal. Most normal plants and fungi have a distinctive view of the world around them, so they don't recognize details about creatures or know anything about the world beyond their immediate vicinity. Cunning plant or fungus monsters are likely to be terse and evasive, while less intelligent ones often make inane comments.

---

Heightened (4th) The duration is 8 hours.

spells.name: Speak with Animals (Constant)
spells.text: You can ask questions of, receive answers from, and use the Diplomacy skill with animals. The spell doesn't make them more friendly than normal. Cunning animals are likely to be terse and evasive, while less intelligent ones often make inane comments.

spells.name: Know the Way
spells.text:
In your mind's eye, you magically reorient yourself. You immediately know which direction is north (if it exists at your current location), and you can choose a location you were at within the last 24 hours and learn what direction it lies.

---

Heightened (3rd) You can choose a location you were at within the last week.

Heightened (7th) You can choose a location you were at regardless of how long ago you were there.

items.name: Greensight
items.text: The wild hunt huntsmaster ignores the Concealed condition from leaves and other foliage, mist, and fog.

items.name: Planar Acclimation
items.text: The wild hunt huntsmaster treats the plane it is located on as its home plane.

items.name: Wild Hunt Link
items.text: 500 feet. Other wild hunt creatures in the area, except wild hunt huntsmasters, add the Knockdown ability to their melee Strikes.

items.name: Instinctive Cooperation
items.text: The wild hunt huntsmaster automatically critically succeeds at saving throws against effects created by allied wild hunt creatures.

items.name: Wild Gaze
items.text: 30 feet. Those who meet the gaze of a wild hunt huntsmaster are overwhelmed by the pressure of the hunt's legacy. A creature that ends its turn in the emanation must succeed at a DC 37 Will save save or be Slowed 1 (Slowed 2 on a critical failure) until it leaves. The wild hunt huntsmaster can deactivate or activate this aura with a single action, which has the concentrate trait.

items.name: Awaken Sword
items.text: The wild hunt huntsmaster awakens their hunting sword, which comes alive in their hands, growing to a massive two-handed blade. Until the start of their next turn, the wild hunt huntsmaster's hunting sword Strike gains the reach trait and deals an additional 2d6 slashing damage.

items.name: Boot on their Neck
items.text:
Requirements A creature within reach is Prone

---
Effect The wild hunt huntsmaster crushes their prey, keeping them down. The required creature must attempt a Fortitude save.

---
Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes half damage and takes a –5-foot penalty to its Speed until the end of its next turn.

Failure The target takes 6d6 bludgeoning damage and is Grabbed until the end of the wild hunt huntsmaster's next turn unless they move.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target takes an additional 3d6 bludgeoning damage each time it uses an attack or move action while grabbed.

items.name: Focus Gaze
items.text: The wild hunt huntsmaster fixes its glare on a creature it can see within 30 feet, which must immediately save against wild gaze. A creature that fails its save and was already slowed by wild gaze is instead Paralyzed for 1 round, after which it is immune to Focus Gaze from any wild hunt creature until the start of the wild hunt huntsmaster's next turn.

items.name: Sneak Attack
items.text: A wild hunt huntsmaster's Strikes deal an additional 3d6 precision damage to Off-Guard creatures.

text:
A wild hunt rarely includes more than one or two huntsmasters, whose primary role is to gather and organize information about the quarry. They're also expert combatants who engage foes that can repel arrows or spells, and strike killing blows against minor quarry unworthy of the monarch's glaive.

---
Although some believe the wild hunt is nothing more than legend, the riders of the hunt are very real, comprised of countless lithe, horned humanoids, along with their steeds and hunting hounds. The term "wild hunt" refers to these fey as a whole, as well as to individual groups who gather at a wild hunt monarch's call to pursue their chosen quarry. The less dangerous a quarry, the more likely a monarch will impose rules to make the hunt more entertaining.
